linked_heading: 7. Cosmology II: dark energy, its drift, and the turnaround
line_text: The [lab notebook](../history/documents/lab-notebook.md) states the mechanism for the program's dark-energy field [τ](../cosmology/dark-energy/tau-quintessence.md) ([#1 §7 item 3](../../notes/broken-born-theory.md#7-cosmology-ii-dark-energy-its-drift-and-the-turnaround); quotations from #1 on this page are transcribed from its LaTeX):

- **#13's dual kinematics.** In [conjugate special relativity](../../conjugate-relativity/_index.md), the dual of velocity is force, and corrections are γ̃ − 1 = (1/2)(F/c̃)², with c̃ = c⁴/G the [maximum force](../../conjugate-relativity/maximum-force.md). For the Sun and Earth, F/c̃ = 2.93×10⁻²² and γ̃ − 1 = 4.3×10⁻⁴⁴. But [#13 §5](../../papers/conjugate-special-relativity.md#5-inertia-dualized) identifies dual rest with free fall ([dual inertia: free fall as rest](../../conjugate-relativity/dual-inertia.md)), which makes the correction zero for any freely falling pair, while [#13 §2](../../papers/conjugate-special-relativity.md#2-force-boosts) says a black-hole merger "operates at F ~ c̃ by construction" ([Open: merger-band corrections](../../conjugate-relativity/force-boosts.md#open-merger-band-corrections)). The two sections disagree: flag 56 in [`review/wiki-build-flags.md`](../../../review/wiki-build-flags.md), rated low, "raised by 1 agent (the run-3 theory verifier), upheld by the final critic". For the Sun and Earth the two readings give 4.3×10⁻⁴⁴ and 0; "both are negligible, but the paper gives two answers" (flag 56).

line_text: The handoff lists among the results that exist only in the claude.ai conversation, not in any document: "**GR-vs-conjugate equation comparison:** slaved layer g̃ = g⁻¹ is algebraic (Einstein's equation does double duty); dual Newtonian limit = Yukawa in momentum = the gate; X-waves massive, 5 polarizations, frequency floor." ([`HANDOFF.md` §4](../../../HANDOFF.md#4-results-that-exist-only-in-the-chat-not-in-any-artifact); GR is general relativity; [a range in momentum](../../gravity/spin-2-fields/yukawa-forces.md#conjugate-special-relativity-a-range-in-momentum).) An algebraic relation gives g̃ no field equation of its own, so the equation that determines g determines g̃ as well. No document derives the comparison, and its status is conjecture ([two gravitational charges and the conjugate field equations (chat-only)](../../gravity/momentum-graviton/chat-only-results.md); [conjectures](../../status/conjectures.md)).

**Gravity as the one link.** P4 lets no gauge force (such as the electromagnetic, weak or strong interaction) act across the two sectors, and its strict reading, the one in force, excludes [kinetic mixing](../../dark-matter/candidates/soliton-candidate/kinetic-mixing.md#what-kinetic-mixing-is) between them (a term in the action coupling the field strengths of the two sectors' photons) beyond what gravity induces ([#11 §4](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#4-postulates)). Conjugate matter then reaches ordinary matter through gravity alone, the basis of [Row 7: a permanent null in direct detection](../../predictions/direct-detection-null.md). Anything built from conjugate matter gravitates, as #11 says of conjugate monopoles: "by P4, conjugate-sector solitons gravitate" ([#11 §11.1](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#111-the-monopole-audit-revised-d); [conjugate monopoles as ontology](../../electric-magnetic-duality/conjugate-monopoles.md)).

The standard-expectation column reads "Eternal de Sitter" in all three versions of the table ([#1 §9 row 6](../../../notes/broken-born-theory.md#9-predictions); [#9 §9 row 5](../../../notes/broken-born-program-v1.md#9-predictions-and-kill-conditions); [#11 §13 row 5](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#13-predictions-and-kill-conditions)). The [lab notebook](../../history/documents/lab-notebook.md)'s requirement named the anti-de Sitter transition directly: "Turnaround after V(τ)<0; AdS transition preferred by current quintessence fits" ([#1 §9 row 6](../../../notes/broken-born-theory.md#9-predictions), transcribed from its LaTeX), AdS being anti-de Sitter ([history of the predictions table](../../predictions/table-history.md)).

Scenario A is the committed-wave case ([Under review: Scenario A and the ultra-faint-dwarf endpoint](../momentum-clumping/wave-island/scenario-a.md)). [The clumping problem](../../history/main-problems.md)'s calculations treat a gas of particles or a wave field, and [its result](../momentum-clumping/net-theorem.md) concerns collective dynamics. A single soliton localized in momentum by its own topology is a case they do not reach ([Open: the topological loophole](../momentum-clumping/topological-loophole.md)). [#11 §9](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#9-momentum-clumping-the-founding-image-tested) ends its account of the clumping problem with "one loophole for individual knots, whose candidate, conjugate monopoles localized in momentum, is P.R.'s open conjecture ([§12](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#12-the-dark-sector-question-three-candidates-and-the-failure-of-one-model))". The conjecture concerns single objects. Collective clumping in momentum space, the founding image, is a separate conjecture of P.R.'s, open, with the evidence of [§9](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#9-momentum-clumping-the-founding-image-tested) against it ([Conjecture: velocity clumping, the founding image](../momentum-clumping/founding-image.md)).

Whether the conjecture's substance includes the program's one phase space at ℏ and strict P4 stays open. "Correlated with ours" holds for most of the group's papers, beyond leading order in the string length and with a strength no paper computes; at leading order the sectors are independent, and [Hübsch and Minic 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.06207) (§5.3) have gravity alone below about 4.5×10¹⁴ GeV. Where the group builds its dark sector, its dual is a coordinate of a doubled phase space at the string length, with a momentum of its own; in its quantum-mechanics papers it is momentum rescaled at ℏ. Whether the conjecture's substance includes the program's one phase space at ℏ and strict P4 stays open. "Correlated with ours" holds for most of the group's papers, beyond leading order in the string length and with a strength no paper computes; at leading order the sectors are independent, and [Hübsch and Minic 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.06207) (§5.3) have gravity alone below about 4.5×10¹⁴ GeV. The group explains past nulls and expects detection, where the program requires a permanent null (row 7). Neither form was found, inside the group or outside it. Beyond the conjecture, the group published before the program a breaking tied to the choice of polarization "at the level of the vacuum sector" ([Freidel, Kowalski-Glikman, Leigh and Minic 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.00802)), for a dual Lorentz symmetry that is not a canonical transformation; U(d)/O(d) as the space of choices of η, and η = HJ; the positive form of [#11 §5](../../papers/broken-born-checkpoint-v2.md#5-the-kinematic-core-and-the-compatibility-theorem)'s compatibility statement; inverse scalings like a·ã = 1; and dark energy from the dual space, with both signs of 1 + w. The spontaneous breaking of the exact ρ with η as order parameter and a potential was not found. Outside the group, [Winn 2012](https://arxiv.org/abs/1206.4590) and his talks of 2025 and 2026 give every charged particle of the Standard Model a magnetically charged partner under our own photon, bound into magnetically neutral composites as dark matter: a close variant of the [shared-photon form](../../electric-magnetic-duality/magnetic-identification.md#shared-photon) of the magnetic mirror without the placement in momentum, and related to the conjectures that dark matter is conjugate matter, of monopoles abundant in momentum space, of their explanation of the null result and of clumping in momentum space (flag 73). A sweep of conference abstracts found the identification only in the group's own talks, and neither form.
